instrucciones.posterTexto: A deck to put your memories in order.

comodin.uso: Before placing a card, ask the deck maker for a hint (“before or after this card?”) or swap one of your cards for the top card of the deck. If they aren’t there, only the swap works.
comodin.clasico: When you miss and end up with more cards than anyone else, take one if there’s one left (one each). Once used, it goes back in the box.
comodin.historia: They belong to the team and each one can be used once. The memory keeper gives the hint.
